name: What is the process for conducting a final walkthrough and accepting renovation work?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for conducting a final walkthrough and accepting renovation work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The final walkthrough is your opportunity to inspect all completed renovation work with your general contractor. Check for any defects, incomplete tasks, or deviations from the agreed-upon plans. Test all new installations, such as appliances, electrical outlets, and plumbing fixtures, to ensure they function correctly. Document any issues with photos and notes. A punch list of items needing correction should be created. Final payment should typically be withheld until all punch list items are satisfactorily completed and addressed by the contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: During the final walkthrough, inspect all work, test installations, and document any issues. Create a punch list for corrections, withholding final payment until completed.
